call_points.text: ESAI (XiDA) business expected to grow over 100% this year on organic growth and acquisitions.
Targeting annualized run rate of ₹375 Cr revenue and ₹84 Cr EBITDA by Q4FY27 from aerospace acquisitions and organic growth.
XiDA added two global technology customers, including a semiconductor equipment maker and a hyperscale AI company.
ADD Solutions, the non-core European unit, posted a ₹4.8 Cr EBITDA loss and ₹6.7 Cr PAT loss; exit targeted by Q4FY27.
Acquisitions are binary; management acknowledged some may slip, though the two main ones are at advanced stages.
FY27 consolidated revenue trending towards ₹1,377 Cr, 52% above the ₹903 Cr retained FY26 base.
₹927 Cr of orders under execution, including the ₹142 Cr deferred from Q4FY26.
₹284-285 Cr assured forecast visibility from design wins with sole or limited source status.
Gross borrowings rose ₹87 Cr to ₹276 Cr for land-systems working capital; no equity dilution planned.
Q4 revenue deferment of ₹142 Cr was due to supply chain disruption and acceptance slot timing, not demand loss.
Management declined to quantify order book or bid pipeline, promising more detail by Q1FY27 results.
Total investment plan for capex and acquisitions is between ₹2,100 to ₹2,250 crores.

operating_notes.text: The transferring business contributed ₹249.30 Cr turnover (24%) and ₹53.00 Cr net worth in FY25.
Consideration of USD 30.63 million comprises USD 17.42 million at closing, USD 5.81 million deferred 12 months and USD 7.4 million earnout on EBITDA at 30 June 2027.
AxisCades announced the transfer of its Heavy Engineering, Energy and Automotive engineering services to Akkodis for USD 30.63 million.

FY26 exceptional items of -₹11.17 Cr included a ₹7.98 Cr goodwill impairment and a ₹4.63 Cr fair-value gain on contingent consideration, plus ₹7.82 Cr of past service cost from the new Labour Codes booked in Q3FY26.
FY26 core Aerospace, Defence and ESAI revenue was about ₹904 Cr (~78% of consolidated revenue); Aerospace ₹388 Cr at 17.3% EBITDA margin, Defence ₹379 Cr at 22.9%, ESAI ₹136 Cr at 26.1%.
Q4FY26 revenue recognition of ₹142 Cr was deferred to Q1/Q2FY27 (₹45 Cr defence, ₹84 Cr strategic electronics, ₹12.60 Cr aerospace), with more than ₹40 Cr of EBITDA impact.
FY26 recorded 27 consolidated design/program wins across radar and electronic warfare, missile and countermeasure systems, aerospace design-to-build, platform electronics and ESAI/deep-tech.
FY26 revenue recognition of 142 crores was deferred to Q1/Q2FY27.
FY26 core domains (aerospace, defense, ESAI) generated ₹904 Cr, about 78% of consolidated revenue.
Qualcomm placed a $3.5 million order in 2-3 months and indicated a monthly pipeline of USD 0.5-1 million.
Land systems WIP of about ₹100 Cr: 20 units ready for dispatch, 25 at assembly, 85 in production, with MoD pre-dispatch inspection in progress.
Defence assured forecast visibility stands at ₹4,557 Cr, to be executed before FY30, with a pipeline exceeding ₹24,000 Cr.
XiDA revenue was ₹49.5 Cr at 33% EBITDA margin, with a business transfer contributing 46% EBITDA margin.
Aerospace manufacturing revenue was ₹6.1 Cr in Q1FY27, with a 30-member leadership team in place ahead of acquisition.
ITSJ Group, Inc. (San Jose, California, incorporated 2023) had unaudited revenue of US$3.37 mn in CY2024 and US$3.47 mn in CY2025.
Consideration: US$2.5 mn cash at completion (US$0.55 mn already advanced as bridge funding), US$2.5 mn restricted XIDA shares vesting over 30 months, and up to US$2.0 mn earn-out over three years.
ITSJ supplies sub-systems to two of the world's top-five semiconductor-equipment manufacturers and a leading hyperscale data-centre operator, with live purchase orders in hand.

Consideration of up to US$7.0 mn (≈₹67 Cr): US$2.5 mn cash at completion, balance in XIDA shares vesting over 30 months, plus earn-out up to US$2.0 mn on customer, revenue and margin milestones; asset purchase leaves ITSJ's legacy liabiliti

timeline.summary: AxisCades approved the ₹2,551 Cr sale of its heavy engineering, automotive, and energy engineering services business to Akkodis for USD 30.63 million.
AxisCades announced the transfer of its Engineering Services practice to Akkodis for USD 30.63 million as part of its transition to an aerospace manufacturing platform.
AXISCADES Technologies Limited, signed by **Sonal Dudani**, scheduled an Earnings Webinar for May 30, 2026, at 04:00 PM (IST) to discuss Q4 & FY2026 results.
AxisCades Aerospace & Technologies won a ₹6.9 Cr Ministry of Defence order for Mobile Mast Systems to be executed in 18 months.
AxisCades announced that its subsidiary won a ₹6.9 Cr order from DRDO for a Mobile Mast System.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹273.01 Cr (+1.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹0.43 Cr (-98.6% YoY).
AXISCADES reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,159 Cr (+12.4% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹178 Cr (+24.6%), with Q4 PAT down 98.7% to ₹0.4 Cr after ₹142 Cr of contracted revenue was deferred to Q1/Q2FY27.
AXISCADES Technologies informed the stock exchanges about the audio recording of its Q4 and FY2026 earnings webinar held on May 30, 2026.
AXISCADES hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings webinar, guiding FY27 revenue to ₹1,377 Cr.
18 Jun 2026: AXISCADES filed an updated Q4 & FY26 earnings webinar transcript, guiding FY27 revenue to ₹1,377 Cr and detailing the Akkodis divestment and ₹142 Cr Q4 revenue deferment.
AXISCADES Technologies completed the acquisition of Swiss firm Ulosia Holding AG as a wholly-owned subsidiary.
2026-10-15: AXISCADES press release detailed XIDA Inc.'s board-approved acquisition of ITSJ Group's business assets for up to US$7.0 mn (≈₹67 Cr), of which US$2.5 mn is cash at completion.
AXISCADES Technologies incorporated a wholly-owned subsidiary, Xponential Space Private Limited, to enter the space technology and aerospace sector.
